  <a class="back-link" href="{{ '/' | relative_url }}">Economy Brief</a>
  <p class="post-meta">Gemini Summary: 9:13PM</p>


<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy pivot:</strong> The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%—the first hike in nearly four years—while raising the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% and inflation projection to 5.2% amid persistent price pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFA2bHZSempFbU1sbTd1dHd2Z2QtYXlYN2RnZ1E2djYtUjVtdFBYaXJnTFdYZUtIVWRPRDdWOUlRa1JJajdPX1gtNWUxWjlkdXVOd0QyQlB1Q3IzQks0aFhhemtrMWowUnVSRHNJNjlsamV5YnNGcE9vM2k1Qk4?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQMmhpbklLbVpqd3IxZjA3bjBUQWJibkpKanlrMm01MVdmcVZuMlFycWNmVkt2Z0puSF90V0N2M1lIX2p6U2tpV2RaREtqNXY3emVxaHRobzRiQl81aGRBeDFoWll4cl81dWJaUGk4V05UaFJLdGFjUU1aZHhaX0pYSkRVY2RXUnUxWlU2anBVRFFscWU5QlZaUC04RzdvVGZlZ0lzZE5CZkhUREx4R0pEUG9meG9zdkV2WGp3Y09B?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I104</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market reaction:</strong> Indian equities snapped a two-day rally, with the Sensex falling over 400 points and the Nifty testing the 22,600 level, as investors reacted to the hawkish &quot;calibrated tightening&quot; stance and rising borrowing costs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I116</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional flows:</strong> FIIs remained net sellers of Indian equities, offloading Rs 6,121 crore on October 7, while DIIs provided partial support with net purchases of Rs 4,597 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I114</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and commodity pressure:</strong> The rupee weakened to 96.57 against the US dollar, pressured by the rate hike, a strong dollar, and crude oil prices holding above $101 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBXMGhGMTJTT2IwTlZjajZzNklBc1JadnJLaERKYml1RlJTLVU4aFM3S1JaV296RVB6dy1ITkpTQkJZS3pRdHY2SVpnaHBiTmxKRnZzUGZ4X0xEUXo5Qkp0bmE5SEh5NkhWWkFhX1lzMFQ1TnBEaWxlNmhaUmI?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond yields and global sentiment:</strong> Indian bond yields inched higher following the policy shift, while US markets opened lower as investors tracked rebounding oil prices and upcoming Federal Reserve minutes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W22</a></span></li>
</ul>
